enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back. Turn to back. Stretch arms. Yawn. Turn to left side again. Pull blanket over head. Lower blanket. Breathe deeply. Remain still.

Sit at table. Eat cereal. Drink milk. Finish eating. Pick up bowl. Walk to sink. Rinse bowl. Place bowl in dishwasher. Rinse spoon. Place spoon in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at workplace. Clock in. Put on scrubs. Wash hands. Pick up clipboard. Enter patient room. Greet patient. Check patient's vital signs. Record data. Administer medication. Assist patient. Walk to nurse station. Update records. Answer phone. Consult with colleague. Take break. Eat lunch. Return to work. See more patients. Record notes. Clock out.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter home. Close door. Remove shoes.

Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add meat. Stir. Turn off stove. Pick up plate. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Finish eating. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Place plate in dishwasher.

Walk to living room. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on couch. Change channel. Watch TV. Get up. Go to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out drink. Return to living room. Sit down. Drink. Put down drink. Change channel. Watch TV.

Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Log in. Open browser. Check email. Read email. Reply to email. Open document. Type. Save document. Open social media. Scroll. Click link. Read article. Close browser. Open game. Play game. Save game. Close game. Shut down computer.
